title: It’s a Wonderful Life (Evangel Alumni Show)
seo_title: It's a Wonderful Life Alumni Show in Springfield, MO
description: It's a Wonderful Life (Evangel Alumni Show) is a Christmas theater production, the first-ever alumni show from Evangel Theatre, with alumni performing alongside current students. It takes place December 5, 2026, with the summary listing performances at 2 p.m. and 7 p.m. that day and a 2 p.m. show on December 6, at 1111 N. Glenstone in Springfield, MO.
address: 1111 N Glenstone Ave, Springfield, MO 65802-2125, United States, Springfield, MO
